agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py: StripTrailingSemicolonFilter.process checked stmt.tokens[-2].value == ';' (off-by-one bug) instead of stmt.tokens[-1].value == ';'. Corrected to check the last token, restoring correct semicolon-stripping behavior for sqlparse.split(sql, strip_semicolon=True), including for procedure statements. Verified fix manually against all reported failing cases and confirmed non-strip behavior remains unaffected.
